svg.text: The 12"-deep built-in between the bath and the living room: pantry at the kitchen end, bookshelves to the living room, cubbies to the bath, glass blocks between the joists above.
Dimensions in inches, rounded to 1/8". Every panel is 3/4" birch plywood unless noted. Drawn from the 3D model (layout.py, CABWALL); nothing is built yet, so measure the room first.
